failureModes.server-reject: Replace only this project's outgoing monogram text with ABC; the actual server rejects it.
failureModes.reject: Synthesize a typed ProjectMutationError response with Connection closed. No request reaches the server.
failureModes.hold: Queue only this project's outgoing icon mutation until monogramEvidence.release().

seed: Create workspaceRoot, then use Add project in the real app to add it and name it projectName.
Open Settings, select projectName, choose Project, then Choose icon.
Evaluate browser.mjs in that browser tab. The first icon mutation pins its project id.
Before each sequence, use Reset project icon to restore Automatic, then Choose icon; choose blue for non-emoji modes.
Set monogramEvidence.mode to pass, hold, server-reject, or reject before Save icon.
Use identical UI inputs and checkpoints on both revisions. Collect full viewport screenshots and environment().
Reload restores the browser instrumentation. Run only with isolated development state.
